agents.reader:
---
name: reader
description: Reads the project
tools: Read, Bash
---
Read and report.

prompt: Have a subagent look at the repository

arguments.command: $env:GH_CONFIG_DIR = "$env:APPDATA\GitHub CLI"; (whoami /groups | Select-String 'Mandatory Label').ToString().Trim().Substring(0, 37); gh --version | Select-Object -First 1; gh auth status 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 2; gh api user --jq .login; gh repo view LeanAndMean/scramjet --json name,visibility; $pr = (gh pr list -R LeanAndMean/scramjet-v1 --state all --limit 1 --json number | ConvertFrom-Json).number; gh pr view $pr -R LeanAndMean/scramjet-v1 --json state; gh release list -R LeanAndMean/scramjet --limit 1; "exit=$LASTEXITCODE"
